About This Job
We are looking to grow our brilliant team of Care Professionals for tea time and evening calls from 19.00 - 20.00.  We provide quality care that makes a real difference to the people we care for at home.  With a minimum of an hour long calls and personalised support with clients who you're matched with, this is home care at its very best.
Our Care Professionals are trained to help our clients remain independent, active and safe.  Every call is different as it's based on the needs of each individual.
As a Home Instead Care Professional, your client visits may consist of:
• Providing personal care.
• Help with medications.
• Preparing meals.
• Light housekeeping.
• Running errands such as accompanying your client to appointments or visiting the shops.
• Helping your client get ready in the morning.
• Offering companionship and conversation.
• Ensuring your client is safe and healthy in their home.
This role is UK-based and the right to work in the UK will need to be established as part of the recruitment process.

Qualifications
No qualifications required.  Full training is provided.  All we ask is that you have a big heart and want to make a difference to our clients lives.

Additional Information
As a Care Professional you will receive industry leading training, great rates of pay and excellent support. Working from 19.00 - 22.00 and working every other weekend.
Benefits include:
• Regular hours and clients
• FREE DBS
• FREE Care Certificate Training
• Introductions/Shadows to all clients
• Enhanced rate of pay at weekends and bank holidays
• Mileage allowance 40p per Mile
• £500 Refer a friend scheme
• Health Care benefits
• Excellent pension scheme
• No 15-minute call company
• Pay Rates - £13.25 per hour
Due to the nature of the role, caring for clients in their own homes and assisting clients to access the community, we require all of our Care Professionals to have a suitable independent means of transport.
We encourage applications from all sections of the community as we want to reflect the neighbourhoods in which we work. Home Instead  is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of adults and expects all staff to share this commitment. This role is subject to DBS enhanced disclosure.

What does being a Live in CAREGiver involve?
•
Living in a client’s home for 2 weeks at a time or more
•
Offering conversation and companionship
•
Administration of medication
•
Assisting with personal care needs
•
Household duties such as cooking, cleaning and laundry
•
Arranging appointments and activities

Home Instead Senior Care Live-in  carers will provide one-one / individuals care for our clients who need regular daily additional support and assistance in day-to-day life.

Interested?
If you're looking for work which is extremely rewarding we would love to hear from you. For more information, please call Chloe on 01420 543214 or email chloe.gardiner@homeinstead.co.uk

About This Job
This is an Individual Contributor (IC) role. As a Enterprise Account Manager at Freshworks, you’ll drive sales into existing defined paying accounts in the UKI region. Your accounts will all have strategic importance to the growth of the region. You will collaborate with teams across Freshworks to manage all aspects of the sales process, including business development, lead management, qualification, evaluation, and closing. You will advocate multiple Freshworks product lines, and as a brand ambassador, you will champion our innovative Software-as-a-Service products to make organizations more productive, efficient and customer-oriented. You will be tasked with increasing spending on existing product lines as well as cross-selling additional products. You will be partly targeted on churn while also managing the whole renewal and uptick process.
Role and Responsibilities
• Drive sales in a defined set of paying accounts to meet or exceed revenue targets in the UKI Market.
• Develop and execute a strategic plan that leads to the creation and maintenance of a robust sales pipeline, including opportunities in existing accounts
• Manage numerous accounts concurrently and strategically
• Manage the renewal process end-to-end
• Work alongside the CSM organization to reduce churn in your book of business
• Provide regular reporting of pipeline and forecasting
• Create and articulate compelling value conversations with C-Level stakeholders and also work in alignment with inside stakeholders, namely AEs, Customer Success, Implementations, Billing, Support, deals teams etc
• Analyze sales/metrics data from your accounts to help evolve your strategy
• Assist customers in identifying industry-relevant use cases and educate customers to make a strong business impact
• Develop long-term strategic relationships with key accounts to maintain best-in-class service and customer satisfaction
• Keep abreast of competition, competitive issues and products
• Participate in team-building and company-growth activities, including strategy setting, sales training, marketing efforts and customer care
• Travel to customer locations in support of sales efforts as and when required

Qualifications
• 7+ years of experience in direct/field sales with SaaS solutions (B2B environment)
• Sales experience with CX, CRM or ITSM products is a strong advantage
• Experience in identifying, developing, negotiating, and closing large-scale technology deals
• Experience in presenting a technology suite of products within an existing portfolio of accounts
• Experience in proactively growing customer relationships while being curious to understand client’s business
• Prior experience in an environment where they managed a book of business in technology sales, which included large growth in net new opportunities
• Consult and translate customer business and technology needs into technology solutions
• Proven track record of consistent territory growth and quota achievement
• Understanding of Customer Experience/Employee Experience in a world of digital business transformation

Additional Information
At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business. Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.

About This Job
Talan is seeking an experienced SAP Solution Architect / Lead Consultant to support the delivery and development of strategic SAP engagements across the UK and Ireland.
This is a senior, client-facing role combining solution architecture, functional leadership, delivery oversight and account management. The successful candidate will act as a trusted advisor to clients, helping them define, implement and optimise SAP solutions that support their business and technology objectives.
The role is suitable for an experienced SAP professional with strong expertise in one or more functional areas and the ability to work across complex enterprise environments, transformation programmes and multidisciplinary teams.
Responsibilities
Client and Account Leadership
• Act as a senior SAP advisor and primary point of contact for key clients.
• Build strong relationships with business, technology and programme stakeholders.
• Manage incoming requirements, assess priorities and coordinate the appropriate delivery resources.
• Maintain oversight of the engagement pipeline, utilisation and future client needs.
• Identify opportunities to extend and strengthen existing client relationships.
Solution Architecture and Functional Leadership
• Lead solution assessments, requirements gathering and end-to-end SAP solution design.
• Translate business requirements into scalable and practical SAP solutions.
• Provide functional leadership across one or more SAP domains.
• Define solution roadmaps aligned with client strategy, enterprise architecture and SAP best practices.
• Support SAP S/4HANA implementation, migration, optimisation and continuous improvement programmes.
• Prepare statements of work, functional specifications and delivery estimates.
Delivery and Quality Management
• Lead functional workstreams across design, configuration, testing, deployment and post-go-live support.
• Coordinate functional consultants, technical teams, developers and integration specialists.
• Ensure the quality and consistency of project deliverables.
• Manage delivery risks, dependencies and issues.
• Support effective knowledge transfer and long-term client capability development.
Team and Practice Development
• Manage, mentor and support SAP consultants.
• Contribute to the development of Talan’s SAP capabilities, methodologies and reusable assets.
• Support recruitment, capability building and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
• Contribute to proposals, client presentations and pre-sales activities where required.

Qualifications
Required Skills and Experience
• Significant experience as an SAP Solution Architect / Lead Consultant.
• Strong knowledge of SAP S/4HANA and enterprise SAP environments.
• Deep expertise in one or more SAP functional domains, including:
• Finance and Controlling
• Procurement and Materials Management
• Sales and Distribution
• Supply Chain and Logistics
• Manufacturing
• Warehouse Management
• Asset Management
• Human Capital Management
• Customer Experience
• Experience delivering SAP implementation, transformation or optimisation programmes.
• Strong understanding of business process design and solution architecture.
• Experience working within complex, multi-site or international organisations.
• Excellent stakeholder management, communication and leadership skills.
Desirable Skills and Experience
• SAP certification.
• Experience with SAP BTP, Fiori, Integration Suite or SAP Analytics Cloud.
• Experience leading large-scale or multi-vendor SAP programmes.
• Knowledge of Agile, Waterfall or hybrid delivery methodologies.
• Experience supporting business development and pre-sales activities.

Additional Information

About This Job
Clifford Chance is proud to be a founding member of PRIME. Through PRIME, we are committed to ensuring that anyone who wants to enter the world of law has an equal chance to do so, regardless of their background.
For many years, obtaining work experience in the legal sector depended largely on who you know rather than what you know. PRIME members have made a commitment to change this by providing fair access to work experience. Our response to this is our bespoke two-year development programme - Clifford Chance ACCESS. This pioneering programme consists of ten different components, each focused around specific core areas of your personal and professional development, culminating in the opportunity to apply for our SPARK programme which may lead to a Training Contract.
More information about the 10 different components of the programme can be found on our website here.
Where applicable, we do provide support with accommodation and travel expenses.

Qualifications
To apply to Clifford Chance ACCESS, you must meet the following qualifying criteria:
• You are in Year 12 (England and Wales), S5 (Scotland) or Lower Sixth (Northern Ireland)
In addition, you must also meet two or more of the following criteria:
• You are attending, and have attended from age 11, a state-funded, non fee-paying school/college.
• You grew up in a household where no parent or guardian attended university.
• You are currently in receipt of, or have previously received, free school meals, Pupil Premium, Education Maintenance Allowance and/or a 16 to 19 Bursary
• You are attending a school or college with a:
a) below average A-level or Higher point score;
and/or
b) low rate of progression to higher education. Please click this link if you need more information on this.
• You have been, or are currently, in local authority care (for a period of three months or longer)
• You are, or have been, a full-time or part-time carer
• You came to the UK as a refugee or asylum seeker

At SIXT, we don't just hire people - we build leadership careers. 1ST GEAR! is our global Management Trainee Program - a dynamic, 12-month journey designed to fast-track your way into a real leadership role. We believe in true entrepreneurship and long-term stability and align our corporate strategy with foresight. Get started with us and apply now!

About This Job
Build and operate the interface, semantic layer and controls that let AI agents work inside IFS software safely.
Key responsibilities
•
Design and build MCP servers (Model Context Protocol, the emerging standard for exposing application capability to agents) over the product’s business objects, treating capability modelling, discoverability, versioning and backward compatibility as first-class design problems.
•
Build the write path that lets an agent safely change a customer’s operational data.
•
Build the semantic layer: an ontology and knowledge graph over the product, generated from what the platform already knows about itself and then curated industry by industry.
•
Build the skills layer that maps what someone asks for onto the correct operation and the correct sequence, with a router that picks between them.
•
Build the control plane: authentication, entitlements, agent identity, telemetry, metering, resistance to injection, and a default that denies rather than permits.
•
Build the evaluation harness that certifies agent behaviour against the real product, and improve the system against what it measures.
•
Build rapid prototypes and proofs of concept to validate emerging technology, product opportunities and customer scenarios.
•
Establish the engineering practices these systems need: evaluation, testing, observability, monitoring, governance, security and operational excellence.
•
Contribute to technical design, review other engineers’ work, and support colleagues coming into the domain.
•
Represent the work outside the team through customer engagements, demonstrations, industry events and partner collaboration.

Qualifications
Strong software engineering first. Everything else is applied on top of that.
•
Production experience building and operating enterprise systems, with real depth in distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, API and schema design, event-driven systems, security, observability and CI/CD.
•
Strong programming in a modern backend language. See the note on language under “Open calls” before advertising.
•
Experience delivering AI systems built on large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows and orchestration frameworks, including tool use, function calling, workflow orchestration and autonomous or multi-agent architectures, with the judgement to know where they fail.
•
Evaluation as a discipline: experimentation, benchmarking, prompt engineering, tracing, quality measurement and agent tuning, improving an agent against evidence rather than impression.
•
Ability to design solutions that integrate enterprise applications, business processes, workflows and data platforms.
•
Depth in at least one of the following:
•
Tool-surface and agent-runtime engineering. MCP servers, tool ecosystems, capability modelling, discoverability, governance, versioning, backward compatibility, multi-tenancy isolation.
•
Knowledge graphs and semantic modelling. Ontology design, context engineering, embeddings, vector databases, retrieval and search technologies, memory architectures, grounding strategies.
•
Enterprise platform depth. Oracle PL/SQL, OData, and comfort working inside large metadata-driven systems where behaviour is configured rather than coded.
Desirable
•
Experience with agent frameworks such as Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, AutoGen, PydanticAI, the OpenAI Agents SDK or CrewAI.
•
Experience building reusable AI platforms, MCP ecosystems or shared engineering capabilities used across multiple products and teams.
•
Containerised platforms and infrastructure automation: Docker, Kubernetes.
•
Experience with Azure, AWS, GCP or another hyperscale cloud platform.
•
Reverse-engineering or interpreter work.
•
Token-efficient agent design.
•
Enterprise software domains: enterprise asset management, service management, manufacturing, supply chain, aerospace and defence, energy, telecommunications, construction, industrial AI.
•
Contributions to open-source projects, technical communities, conferences, publications or standards.

About This Job
Reporting to the Senior Supply Chain Specialist, the Supply Chain Engineer will support the development, delivery and improvement of Mitsubishi Power’s regional supply chain across EMEA. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent Mechanical Engineering graduate, or an early-career engineer, who wants to build a specialist career in technical supply chain, supplier development and engineering services.
The role is not designed for someone who already has extensive supply chain experience. Instead, we are looking for someone with a strong mechanical engineering foundation, the ability to understand technical drawings and specifications, and the curiosity to learn how engineering, procurement, suppliers, quality and logistics work together to support major gas turbine, steam turbine and power generation service projects.
You will receive support and training to develop into a skilled Supply Chain Engineer, helping Mitsubishi Power EMEA source, develop and improve the supply of components, parts, consumables, tooling and spares across the region.
What will you do in the role?
• Support the development of the regional supply chain for engineering components, including parts, consumables, tooling and other spares.
• Review technical drawings, specifications and component information to help identify suitable supply chain and procurement routes.
• Work closely with Engineering, Repairs and Procurement teams to assess whether parts and components can be sourced locally or directly within the EMEA region.
• Develop your understanding of gas turbines, steam turbines and associated components, including materials, manufacturing methods and technical requirements.
• Help identify opportunities to reduce cost, improve lead times and strengthen supplier capability, while maintaining Mitsubishi Power’s quality standards.
• Support the resolution of supply chain issues from initial request through to delivery to site.
• Liaise with Engineering, Procurement, Quality, Inventory and Logistics, suppliers and Programme Management teams to help resolve technical and supply chain challenges.
• Build relationships with regional and global engineering and procurement colleagues, including teams based in Leeds, London and across the wider EMEA region.
• Support supplier and component development activities by gathering technical information, reviewing requirements and helping coordinate actions across internal teams.
• Prepare updates, reports and progress summaries for Supply Chain and Procurement management.
• Develop broader commercial and project awareness by working with departments such as Engineering, Programme Management, Procurement and Commercial.

Qualifications
What are we looking for?
We are looking for a recent graduate or early-career engineer who is keen to develop into a technical supply chain role. You do not need to have a background in supply chain or procurement, but you should have a genuine interest in how engineered components are sourced, manufactured, assessed and delivered.
You should be able to demonstrate:
• A degree or relevant qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering or a closely related discipline.
• A good understanding of mechanical engineering principles.
• The ability to read and interpret technical and engineering drawings.
• An interest in materials, components, manufacturing methods and how engineering requirements are translated into supplier capability.
• A willingness to learn about gas turbines, steam turbines and power generation service technology.
• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to review information carefully and draw practical conclusions.
• Good written communication skills, including the ability to produce clear technical updates and reports.
• Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
• Strong verbal communication skills, with the confidence to liaise with colleagues across Engineering, Procurement, Quality, Logistics and Programme Management.
• A professional, diplomatic and collaborative approach.
• A self-driven mindset, with the ability to work independently while asking the right questions and learning from experienced colleagues.

At Mitsubishi Power EMEA, we are committed to building a workplace where people feel respected, included and able to contribute.

jobs.smartrecruiters.com/wise/7440001515.description_excerpt:
About This Job
We're looking for an Engineering Lead to manage the Platform team within the Business Onboarding Verification (BOV) organisation — based in London. This team owns the platform rails that Business verification is built on; the sister team (BOV Global) uses those rails to ship customer-facing journeys and agent tooling. There are three organisations in the wider squad — Business Onboarding Verification, Personal Onboarding Verification, and Wise Platform Verification.
The scale we operate at
•
In FY2025, 15.6M people and businesses used Wise; we onboarded over 5.9M new customers (~500K/month) and moved £145B across borders (~£400M/day) across 160+ countries and 40+ currencies.
•
Our onboarding decisions gate ~£25B/year in cross-currency volume.
•
Verification is on the critical path for every new signup and for ~10 product teams across Wise that build on our rails today.
Our verification systems are not supporting tools — they are core production infrastructure that protects customers, enables growth, and must stay reliable under constant change in regulations, policies and evolving threat patterns.
The team you'll lead - Verification Platform
You will lead the Verification Platform (under BOV) team in London — a cross-functional engineering team whose mission is to provide the BOV platform (Onboarding Platform for business, requirement evaluation, collection, review, unified vendor integrations, repapering rails) that lets BoV Global and regional teams iterate safely and quickly on business verification without rebuilding plumbing. Concretely, this team owns three work-streams:
•
Onboarding Platform (for business) — modelling Business requirements as configuration-as-a-service, per legal-entity type (Ltd, LLC, Sole Trader, Partnership, Corp), with versioned rules and repapering / refresh rails so a policy change is a config choice, not a multi-quarter project.
•
Review tooling platform — the review surface on which Global (and regional teams) build their review flows; the foundation that makes AI-assisted review and review automation measurable and safe to roll out.
•
Unified Vendor Integrations — one observable, retryable, swappable gateway for registry, adverse media, website signal, Acceptable Use Policy and Business Onboarding data vendors, replacing today's point-to-point integrations.
Your mission
As the Engineering Lead for BOV Platform, you will:
•
Lead, coach and mentor a cross-functional team of engineers — supporting their growth, well-being and performance, and empowering them to do their best work.
•
Own the technical roadmap for the BOV platform — make sure it addresses real reliability, security and scalability concerns of the Business verification stack.
•
Partner deeply with BOV Global, Personal Onboarding, Wise Platform Verification and Mitigation Handling so the platform serves real product needs — not what the platform team thinks the platform should be.
•
Be an active contributor to delivery. Support day-to-day execution, get hands-on when the team absolutely needs it, and stay in touch with the technology stack — leading by example.
•
Own the health and productivity of the team, fostering a culture of ownership, transparency, bottom-up decision-making, collaboration and continuous improvement — the way Wise engineering works.
•
Own operational excellence. Ensure appropriate on-call rotas, SLAs, documentation and observability for platform services; run incidents in your area of ownership and turn each into a durable fix.
•
Collaborate globally with engineering leads across Global KYC and Onboarding (London, Tallinn, Budapest and Hyderabad) and the wider Wise engineering community.
•
Run the engineering rituals of the team so we stay agile and predictable in product development.
Why this is an exciting problem
Picture a pharmaceutical company incorporated in Singapore, with one shareholder living in Dubai, trading in the UK and Singapore. In one signup, that business touches at least four regulatory perimeters — Singapore, UK, UAE for the shareholder, plus industry-specific controls for pharma (enhanced due diligence, sanctions, source-of-funds). Our job is to work out — in real time — exactly what each regulator needs, verify it against the right sources, and hand the customer a signup that feels effortless. Now scale that across 160+ countries and the millions of businesses we have. BOV Platform is building the framework that makes this possible without a new (or at most minimal) codebase per market, and the interesting problems stack up:
•
Configuration-driven, versioned rules at scale. How do we express "what KYC do we need for entity type × country × industry × partner × risk tier?" as data — hot-reloadable, auditable, and safe to change weekly — while giving regulators a clean audit trail of which version passed which customer?
•
Distributed decisioning under real-world latency. A single verification decision fans out to 10+ internal services and external vendors (registry lookups, sanctions, PEP, document verification, ML models). Sagas, idempotency, timeouts, and graceful degradation all matter — because "we couldn't reach the sanctions provider" isn't an acceptable customer experience.
•
Consistency vs. availability on the KYC decision path. The same customer hits us from web, mobile and partner APIs concurrently. Where is strong consistency non-negotiable (a compliance-gated transfer) vs. eventual consistency fine (background re-screening)? How do we avoid decision drift across regions and entities?
•
Event-driven re-evaluation and repapering. Rules change; a country updates its policy; a customer's risk profile shifts. How do we re-decide retroactively across millions of customers without stampeding downstream systems or ops queues?
•
ML/AI in the loop — safely. Where does automation genuinely help (document classification, risk scoring, agent copilots), where does it not, and how do we ship it with safe fallbacks, clear observability and a human review path that doesn't become the bottleneck?
That's the problem your team will help solve — with real regulatory teeth, real customer impact, and enough platform surface area to keep senior engineers engaged for years.

Qualifications
A bit about you
•
You have proven experience leading and mentoring software engineers, including managing performance, well-being and growth, and handling difficult situations constructively (360 feedback, calibration, performance reviews).
•
You have built and led platform / infrastructure teams whose customers are other engineering teams — you know how to say no, how to prioritise for leverage, and how to keep a platform from turning into a bespoke-request queue.
•
You have solid Java (17+) knowledge and hands-on experience with Spring / Spring Boot, and you're happy to stay hands-on when the team needs it.
•
You have strong system-design skills with real experience of distributed, high-throughput, resilient services — event-driven architectures

Contract: Full Time Permanent

Rebuilding your life after sentencing is one of the toughest challenges a person can face. But with the right support, it’s possible. That’s where you come in.
We’re looking for a Personal Well-being Advisor — someone with a rare mix of compassion, resilience, organisation and flexibility. This is for the person who understands that rehabilitation isn’t just about offering advice; it’s about rolling up your sleeves and pro-actively supporting someone on their journey.
This is a demanding role; you'll be working in a challenging environment with people who have complex needs and who can be reluctant to engage. But when you help someone break the cycle and you see them take real steps toward transforming their life, it’s a great feeling.

You will support a caseload of service users that may have been previously released from prison, on a suspended sentence or on community orders. Based out of the local probation office you will be working collaboratively with pre-release teams, probation and other internal departments to support them on their journey.
You will need to be able to juggle multiple individuals at once, ensuring each person gets the support they need, while keeping meticulous records of every interaction.
You'll often be able to plan your own schedule, but you will need to be able to prioritise effectively - it’s a challenging role where no day will be the same.

• Assessments and Action Plans: You will complete personal wellbeing assessments and create tailored action plans for each individual you work with. You will guide individuals as per their action plan, helping them reintegrate through practical well-being activities.
• Collaboration: Your intervention may be part of a wider support package so collaborating with internal and external colleagues is a key part of the role.
• Caseload Management: You’ll manage multiple individuals, balancing their needs while keeping up with all the related admin.
• Partnership Working: Identify relevant local organisations to enhance the offering to our service users.

• Safeguarding awareness: You are supporting complex individuals at a challenging time in their lives and will need to be able to identify any safeguarding risks.
• IT and Administrative skills: Keeping meticulous records of every interaction to measure client progress and ensure effective interventions.
• Organisation: You can handle a busy caseload and stay on top of detailed records.
• Resilience: This role can be challenging, and results may take time, but you are the kind of person who stays committed and sees things through.

About This Job
About the Role:
We are seeking an experienced Landing Gear Dynamics Engineer to join a growing engineering team supporting the development, analysis, and verification of advanced landing gear systems. This role will focus on multibody dynamics modelling, simulation, and analysis, supporting the full engineering lifecycle from concept development through to customer demonstrations and design reviews.
The successful candidate will have a strong background in dynamic systems analysis and multibody simulation, using industry-standard tools to assess the performance, stability, and behaviour of landing gear systems in complex operational environments.
This is an excellent opportunity to work on technically challenging aerospace programmes within a collaborative engineering environment, contributing to the development of high-integrity engineering solutions.
Key Responsibilities:
• Develop and maintain multibody dynamics models for landing gear systems and associated mechanical assemblies.
• Perform dynamic simulations and analyses to evaluate system performance, loads, stability, and behaviour throughout operational scenarios.
• Support design activities through the interpretation of simulation results and provision of engineering recommendations.
• Produce technical reports, analysis documentation, and verification evidence to support engineering requirements.
• Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams including systems, structural, mechanical, and integration engineers.
• Support technical reviews including Preliminary Design Reviews (PDRs) and customer-facing engineering demonstrations.

Qualifications
Required Skills:
• Significant experience as a Landing Gear Dynamics Engineer, Multibody Dynamics Engineer, Dynamics Engineer, or similar engineering role.
• Strong background in multibody dynamics (MBD) modelling and simulation.
• Proven experience using MSC Adams (Hexagon Adams).
• Experience carrying out dynamic analysis of complex mechanical systems.
• Ability to interpret engineering requirements and translate them into simulation models and analytical solutions.
• Experience producing technical reports and presenting engineering findings to technical audiences.
• Strong understanding of mechanical system behaviour, dynamics, kinematics, and load analysis.
• Excellent stakeholder communication and problem-solving skills.
• Minimum 10 years of relevant engineering experience.
Required Qualifications:
• A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, or equivalent military experience.
Desirable Skills:
• Experience using Simcentre MotionSolve, Simpack, Ansys Motion, or similar multibody simulation tools.
• Experience with VI Aircraft software.
• Previous aerospace or landing gear engineering experience.
• Experience presenting dynamic simulations and analysis results during customer-facing design reviews and PDR activities.
• Familiarity with systems engineering and verification processes within highly regulated industries.

We bring together entrepreneurial, tech-driven people to deliver innovative solutions for leading companies.

About This Job
The Staff Power Architect – System Design is responsible for architecture definition, modeling, and technical leadership for PMIC and advanced DC/DC converter products. This role provides architectural ownership and technical leadership from concept through silicon validation. The role works closely with analog design, digital, verification, validation, test, and product engineering teams to ensure alignment of architecture intent, implementation, and verification across multiple programs.
Key Responsibilities
System Architecture & Technical Leadership
- Define and own architectures for PMIC and advanced power converter products across multiple programs.
- Drive architecture trade-offs and define operating modes, startup and shutdown sequencing, and system boundary conditions.
- Lead architecture reviews and remain deeply involved during the design phase to ensure the transition from architecture to design execution is carried out correctly.
- Provide architectural leadership and technical guidance for system-level design decisions across projects.
Modeling & Analysis
- Develop and maintain low-level and system-level models to support architecture decisions and risk reduction, using tools such as Simplis.
- Analyze stability, transient response, fault behavior, and corner cases to support architecture definition and validation.
- Provide model-based insight to support analog design convergence and reduce silicon risk.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
- Collaborate with analog design, digital, verification, validation, test, and applications teams to ensure architecture intent is implemented and verified.
- Participate in design and architecture reviews and technical discussions across multiple programs.
- Provide technical guidance during silicon validation and system-level debug activities.
Documentation & Knowledge Capture
- Create and maintain architecture documentation, design guidelines, and best-practice references.
- Create detailed sub-block specifications that enable design and verification teams to execute implementation and verification activities efficiently.
- Capture lessons learned, root causes, and preventive actions to improve future designs.
- Contribute to internal training, workshops, and technical knowledge-sharing activities.

Qualifications
Required Qualifications
- Strong experience in PMICs, DC/DC converters, or mixed-signal power systems.
- Experience with architecture definition and architectural analysis for power management products.
- Familiarity with modeling tools such as Simplis and Simulink.
- Ability to work across disciplines and influence technical decisions through collaboration and technical credibility.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills for technical documentation and reviews.
Nice to Have
- Experience contributing to advanced power converter programs.
- Familiarity with emerging architectures such as Multi-Level Converter (MLC) topologies.
- Familiarity with multi-rail power systems and power sequencing.
- Experience supporting silicon bring-up, validation, and root-cause analysis.

Additional Information
What Success Looks Like
- Architectures are clearly defined and consistently implemented across projects.

As a Live-In Carer at Home Instead, you will play a pivotal role in helping clients maintain their independence and comfort within their own homes. About This Job
The role
This role will focus on synthetic securitisation and Significant Risk Transfer (SRT) transactions, advising leading global financial institutions on regulatory capital management, balance sheet optimisation and structured credit solutions. The work will include funded and unfunded synthetic securitisations, credit risk transfer structures, portfolio risk transfer transactions and related structured credit products. You will work on innovative, market-leading transactions across multiple jurisdictions and asset classes.
Who you will work with
We advise on a broad range of structured finance transactions, including structured products, derivatives, CLOs and securitisations across asset classes and jurisdictions. Our work covers public and private issuances, repackagings, synthetic and cash structures, warehouses and risk transfer transactions. We act for originators, arrangers, investors, and collateral managers on complex structures, supporting clients to navigate regulatory requirements and execute transactions in evolving securitisation markets.
What you will be responsible for
The majority of our work is cross-border and international, advising banks, insurers, investors and alternative capital providers on complex risk transfer transactions. You can expect to take a lead role on SRT and synthetic securitisation matters, including structuring, transaction execution, regulatory analysis, investor negotiations and ongoing programme development. You will work closely with colleagues across Structured Finance, Regulatory, Tax and Derivatives practices to deliver integrated solutions to clients.
Awards and Accolades
The group has been consistently ranked highly in Chambers UK for "Financial Services: UK-wide" & Legal 500 "Financial Services" categories. Some of our recent awards and rankings include:
• Band 1: Capital Markets: Structured Finance, Securitisation & Derivatives
Chambers Global 2021
• Band 1: Derivatives
Legal 500 UK 2021
• Band 1: Structured Products and Securitisation
Legal 500 UK 2021
• Band 1: Structured Finance and Securitisation
IFLR1000 2020
• Band 1: Derivatives
IFLR1000 2020

Qualifications
Your experience
We are interested in Mid – Senior Level lawyers with experience in synthetic securitisation, SRT transactions, portfolio risk transfer, securitisation and structured finance. Experience advising financial institutions on regulatory capital optimisation initiatives, capital relief trades, credit linked note programmes or funded and unfunded risk transfer transactions would be particularly valuable.
Candidates may come from leading securitisation, structured finance, derivatives or banking practices and should demonstrate strong technical drafting skills, commercial judgment and an interest in the evolving regulatory capital and risk transfer market. We are open to candidates based in other leading financial centres with relevant experience.

About This Job
JOB DESCRIPTION
You will join NBCUniversal’s Corporate Legal Affairs team and play an important role in supporting the governance, compliance and administration of the company’s international legal entities. In addition to primary responsibility for the UK portfolio, you will oversee and coordinate company secretarial matters for entities in other jurisdictions, working with local counsel, external providers and internal stakeholders as appropriate. Working closely with colleagues across Legal, Tax, Finance, Treasury, Risk Management and the business, you will provide practical company secretarial support and help maintain accurate, efficient and reliable corporate records and processes.
In this role, you will support board and shareholder activity, statutory filings, entity transactions, governance projects and day-to-day corporate structure requests. You will serve as a trusted point of contact for internal stakeholders and external advisers, using sound judgment to prioritize work, identify issues and escalate matters when appropriate.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
• Coordinate board and committee meetings for the principal international licensing entity, including preparing agendas, collating and distributing board materials, attending meetings and drafting accurate minutes.
• Draft board, shareholder and general meeting minutes, written resolutions, certificates and related corporate approvals for a range of matters.
• Manage entity lifecycle and governance matters across the international portfolio, with primary responsibility for UK entities and responsibility for overseeing and coordinating incorporations, dissolutions, name changes, updates to company details, statutory filings and related activities in other jurisdictions with the Corporate Secretary team, local counsel and external providers.
• Maintain complete and accurate statutory registers, minute books, entity records and supporting documentation, and help ensure corporate information is updated promptly in the company’s entity management system.
• Support compliance with the Companies Act 2006 and other applicable legal and regulatory requirements, including review and coordination of statutory accounts, confirmation statements and other filings.
• Coordinate the corporate-law aspects of dividends and other distributions, share allotments, capital reductions and injections, share transfers, and share consolidations, subdivisions and redesignations, working with Tax and Finance as appropriate.
• Prepare and maintain organization charts and respond to ad hoc requests concerning ownership, governance and corporate structure.
• Support KYC, due diligence, banking and Treasury requests by coordinating company and director information and documentation.
• Liaise with external entity management providers, lawyers, auditors, notaries and other professional advisers, and monitor completion of assigned filings and deliverables.
• Provide practical corporate governance and compliance guidance to internal stakeholders across NBCUniversal and Comcast Corporate.
• Support cross-border governance projects, subsidiary reorganizations and other corporate transactions, coordinating stakeholders, deliverables and approvals from planning through completion.
• Help improve and streamline governance, entity management and compliance processes, including templates, policies, guidance, terms of reference, reporting and data-quality controls.
• Monitor relevant developments in company law, regulation and corporate governance practice and help translate changes into practical guidance and process updates.
• Build strong working relationships across functions and geographies while handling sensitive and confidential information with appropriate care.

Qualifications
QUALIFICATIONS
Basic Requirements:
• Relevant company secretarial, legal or corporate governance qualification, or equivalent professional experience.
• Demonstrable post-qualification or equivalent experience in a fast-paced commercial organization, professional services firm or in-house legal or company secretarial team.
• Strong working knowledge of the Companies Act 2006 and UK company secretarial requirements, including statutory registers, filings and board and shareholder procedures.
• Experience preparing board and shareholder materials, minutes, written resolutions and corporate records with a high level of accuracy.
• Experience supporting legal-entity transactions and lifecycle matters, including incorporations, dissolutions, changes to company details, share issuances or transfers, distributions or capital actions.
• Experience using an entity management database or comparable corporate records system for data maintenance, reporting and document management.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong numeracy and exceptional attention to detail.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines, exercise sound judgment and identify when matters should be escalated.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

​Do you have experience in hydrology, hydraulic modelling and flood risk assessment, and want to apply it to challenging projects in the UK and internationally?
​Would you enjoy solving complex water-related problems across infrastructure, climate resilience, water management, mining and hydropower projects?

​Your new role
​You will join our UK Water team as an experienced hydrologist and hydraulic modeller, bringing strong technical expertise and relevant consultancy or industry experience. You will apply your knowledge of hydrology, hydraulic modelling and flood risk assessment across a varied portfolio of projects. Our work ranges from UK infrastructure and development schemes to major international assignments involving climate resilience, water management, mining, hydropower and technical due diligence. Working alongside specialists from across Ramboll, you will contribute to multidisciplinary projects while continuing to develop your technical expertise, project delivery experience and client relationships. The role will suit someone who enjoys solving complex problems, critically evaluating technical information and working collaboratively across disciplines. You will also have opportunities to contribute to the continued growth and development of our hydrology and flood risk capability.

• ​Undertaking and, as your experience develops, leading hydrological assessments, flood risk studies and hydraulic modelling for infrastructure, water management and climate resilience projects.
• ​Applying appropriate hydrological and hydraulic modelling techniques, including critical evaluation of data, assumptions, model performance and results.
• ​Providing clear, technically robust advice to clients and multidisciplinary project teams, translating complex hydrological and modelling outputs into practical project decisions.
• ​Contributing to a diverse portfolio of UK and international projects, including major infrastructure, development, mining, water management, hydropower and technical due diligence assignments.
• ​Supporting project delivery, technical quality, proposals and client development while sharing knowledge and supporting less experienced colleagues.
​About you
• ​A degree, or equivalent professional experience, in hydrology, civil or environmental engineering, geography or another relevant discipline.
• ​Strong relevant professional experience in hydrology, flood risk assessment and/or hydraulic modelling, typically gained over around five years or more in consultancy, industry or a similar environment.
• ​Practical experience of hydrological analysis and established hydraulic modelling software such as TUFLOW, Flood Modeller or HEC-RAS, together with an understanding of current UK flood hydrology methods.

• ​Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with clients and colleagues from different technical disciplines.

• ​Matched pension contributions

​​
​​Ready to join us?

So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. At GSK, we are actively working on building a future in which state-of-the-art software, Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) enable us to develop new therapies and personalized medicines that drive better outcomes for patients at reduced cost with fewer side effects. This ambitious mission requires scalable, cloud-native solutions at the forefront of Software Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, Efficient Compute, Machine Learning and AI. About the Role
To strengthen our AI for Science (AI4S) team, we are looking for Software Engineers with a track record in developing production-grade, data-driven software solutions. You will design, build and operate the scalable cloud infrastructure and services — including the serving of our models — that our AI systems and agentic applications run on, and you will be accountable for keeping them reliable in production. This is hands-on software and platform engineering: building robust, well-tested, high-performance systems that scientists across GSK depend on every day, on modern cloud technology and the vast biomedical data sources available to us.
Team Culture
The AI4S team is built on the principles of ownership, accountability, continuous development, and collaboration. We hire for the long term, and we are motivated to make this a great place to work. Our leaders will be committed to your career and development from day one. We strongly encourage applications from people with diverse and underrepresented backgrounds and perspectives.
In this role you will
•
Design, build and operate scalable infrastructure and services that support our AI models and agentic systems across the entire software development life cycle.
•
Own the reliability of what you build — set up CI/CD and release processes, automated testing, monitoring and alerting, and lead the response when things break, so the systems scientists rely on stay dependable.
•
Build and operate the model-serving infrastructure that exposes our models in production with efficient use of compute.
•
Develop and maintain cloud-native architectures that enable reliable deployment and scaling of AI/ML workloads.
•
Deliver robust, tested and high-performance code in an agile environment, and work closely with ML engineers and domain experts to make the infrastructure fit for purpose.
Why you?
Qualifications & Skills
We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:
•
A degree in a quantitative or engineering discipline (e.g., computer science, computational biology, bioinformatics, engineering, among others); OR equivalent work experience as a professional software engineer.
•
Demonstrated advanced programming expertise in Python and in developing and delivering robust, scalable software solutions using frameworks like FastAPI.
•
Experience with cloud platforms (GCP, Azure) and cloud-native architectures.
•
Passion for software design and commitment to the development of reusable, scalable, and testable software components.
•
Basic understanding of at least one major deep learning framework (PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow).
•
Knowledge of command-line tools and shell scripting.
•
Knowledge of software engineering best practices, including continuous integration (CI) and continuous deployment (CD), containerization, and infrastructure as code.
•
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, and experience working in cluster settings or cloud-based environments.
•
Experience operating production services — monitoring, observability and alerting, and diagnosing and resolving issues in live systems.
•
Experience designing and administering SQL databases — schema design, query performance, and day-to-day operational management.
•
Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform, in particular the services we build on: Cloud Run, Google Kubernetes Engine, Cloud Storage, Artifact Registry, Cloud SQL.
•
Fluency in English.
Preferred Qualifications & Skills
If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:
•
Familiarity with machine learning principles and state-of-the-art modelling approaches.
•
Experience in design, development and deployment of commercial cloud-native software and infrastructure.
•
Experience building and deploying large-scale AI models and agentic systems in production environments.
•
Experience architecting, developing, and deploying distributed training pipelines for large models with PyTorch or TensorFlow.
•
Expertise in performance optimization, cost optimization, and efficient compute resource management in cloud environments.
•
Experience running production services at scale, including defining and working to service-level objectives (SLOs/SLIs).
•
Experience with incident response and post-incident review, and with building the observability that supports it.
•
Infrastructure-as-code (e.g. Terraform) for provisioning and maintaining cloud environments.
•
Experience developing and administering workloads on Kubernetes (e.g. GKE).
•
Familiarity with GCP networking and security controls — VPC, VPC Service Controls (VPC-SC), and private connectivity.
•
Contributions to relevant open-source projects.
•
Knowledge or interest in disease biology, molecular biology and medicine.
•
Experience working with biomedical data (e.g., genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, electronic health records, clinical images).

·       Creating ad hoc simulations for alternative Supply/Stock profile/Capacity scenarios to inform key business decisions

About this role
Your team
Technology underpins everything we do at BlackRock, and Artificial Intelligence (AI) is a strategic priority across Aladdin and our investment, client, and operational platforms. Within Aladdin Platform Engineering, our team builds and operates the foundational infrastructure and platform services that enable machine learning, large language models, and emerging AI capabilities to run securely, reliably, and at enterprise scale.
We work across AI Engineering, Data Science, Platform Engineering, Security, Risk, and Product to build resilient, cloud-native platforms for a highly regulated environment. This role offers the opportunity to shape the engineering foundations that enable AI capabilities across Aladdin.
Your role and impact
As an AI Infrastructure Engineer, you will design, build, and operate the foundational platforms that support AI workloads throughout their lifecycle, from development and experimentation through training, evaluation, deployment, and inference.
You will help create scalable, reliable production environments while embedding security, governance, observability, automation, and operational resilience into the platform. You will contribute to architectural decisions and technical standards as AI capabilities and infrastructure continue to evolve across Aladdin.
Your responsibilities
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
• Design, build, and operate scalable, reliable, and secure cloud-native infrastructure supporting AI model development, training, evaluation, deployment, and inference across public cloud and hybrid environments.
• Partner with AI Engineering, Data Science, Platform Engineering, and Product teams to improve developer experience, platform performance, and operational stability while contributing to AI platform architecture and technical standards.
• Enable production deployment of machine learning models and large language models within governed enterprise environments, integrating identity, access controls, data protection, security, and risk requirements.
• Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation to enable repeatable, consistent, and auditable platform provisioning and configuration.
• Build and operate observability, monitoring, and alerting capabilities that provide visibility into AI platform availability, performance, reliability, capacity, and cost.
• Participate in operational support and on-call rotations for critical platforms, contributing to incident response and resilient production services.
• Evaluate emerging AI infrastructure technologies and engineering approaches, applying capabilities appropriate to BlackRock’s enterprise environment.
Your experience
• Demonstrated experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, systems engineering, or a closely related discipline, including designing and operating services across major public cloud and hybrid environments.
• Experience supporting AI and machine learning platforms across the development and production lifecycle, including training, fine-tuning, experimentation, validation, model deployment and serving, lifecycle management, observability, resilience, disaster recovery, and end-to-end Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) pipelines.
• Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code, cloud infrastructure provisioning, and automation, supported by programming or scripting capability.
• Experience building and operating enterprise-grade containerized platforms that support declarative infrastructure and horizontal scaling, with a strong understanding of reliability, scalability, observability, and production engineering practices.
• Familiarity with graphics processing unit (GPU) or other accelerator-based AI infrastructure, multicloud architectures, and enterprise governance requirements.
• Ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, security, risk, data, and product teams and communicate complex technical concepts clearly. Experience in financial services or another highly regulated environment is beneficial.
Our benefits
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of employee benefits including: retirement investment and tools designed to help you in building a sound financial future; access to education reimbursement; comprehensive resources to support your physical health and emotional well-being; family support programs; and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
Our hybrid work model
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
Guidance on AI use for candidates
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
About BlackRock
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being.  Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and…

Data Analyst (Tech Insurance Operations)
Role Overview
We are seeking a highly analytical and technically capable Data Analyst to support the development of a data-driven claims function. This role will report directly to the Head of Claims and will work closely with TPAs, and Vave’s   Underwriting, Operations, and Technology teams.
The Data Analyst will be responsible for extracting, analysing, reconciling, and interpreting claims data to support operational oversight, reserving discipline, TPA performance, underwriting feedback, and portfolio profitability. The ideal candidate will have strong experience with SQL, Excel, data validation, reporting and claims analysis
This is a hands-on role for someone who can transform data into insight, and help the business make better claims, underwriting, and financial decisions.
Key responsibilities
Data Analysis
• Analyse claims data from internal systems, TPAs data feeds, bordereaux reports, and data warehouses.
• Use SQL to query claims databases, validate data quality, build recurring extracts, and support ad hoc analysis.
• Work within an Azure Databricks environment, utilising SQL, and Python skills to automate claims analysis and oversight reporting.
• Operational reporting, severity analysis, reserving reviews, claims feedback for underwriting.
• Identify and investigate data quality concerns.
• Translate claims data into clear insights, trends, exceptions, and recommended actions.
Claims MI, Reporting & Dashboards
• Shape recurring claims management information, dashboards, KPI packs, and executive reporting.
• Track and report on key claim metrics.
• Support the creation of board, capacity partner, underwriting, and actuarial reporting packs.
Actuarial & Underwriting Support
• Support reserve reviews, loss development analysis, large loss monitoring, data reconciliations, and claims trend analysis.
• Partner with Underwriting to provide claim insights that inform risk selection, pricing, appetite, policy wording, exclusions, endorsement, and portfolio strategy.
• Support development of claims feedback loops that connect loss experience back to underwriting action.
Rules Engine, Scoring & Claims Intelligence
• Support the build-out of claims rules, escalation triggers, severity scoring models and exception reporting.
• Participate in UAT for claims systems, rules engines, dashboards, portals, data feeds, and workflow tools.
• Translate business requirements from Claims into technical data logic, SQL predicates, reporting rules, and test cases.
Required experience
• 3+ years of experience in data analytics within the financial/insurance sector
• Ability to work with incomplete, inconsistent, or complex data sources.
• Strong SQL querying and data manipulation skills.
• Advanced Excel and data reconciliation skills.
• Preferred knowledge of any of the following: laims analytics, insurance data analysis, claims operations, actuarial support, underwriting analytics, TPA oversight, or related insurance analytics roles.
• Experience working within Azure Databricks (preferred), using notebooks to analyse and transform data, and leveraging Azure data services such as Azure SQL, Data Lake Storage, and cloud-based data platforms.
• Experience extracting and analysing data from systems or reporting platforms, including Lloyd’s/delegated authority bordereaux.
• Demonstrated ability to analyse complex datasets and present findings in a clear, concise, business-relevant manner.
Preferred experience
• Prior experience with a TPA, MGA, MGU, insurance carrier, or reinsurer within a delegated authority business.
• Experience working with Actuarial and Underwriting teams.
• Familiarity with claims bordereaux, delegated authority reporting, capacity partner reporting, or reinsurance reporting.
• Experience with Databricks, Synapse, or similar analytics tools.
• Understanding of claims leakage, severity management, reserve adequacy, litigation trends, fraud indicators, subrogation, and vendor performance.

• Building an understanding of the products and services we provide for our customers and colleagues
• Attending Engineering specific networking events, social engagements and the opportunity to hear from senior leaders across the bank
How you’ll benefit
We’ll reward you with a starting salary of £29,400 pro rata.
Plus, you can expect to:
• Learn from industry experts and immediately apply your learnings
• Enrich your learning with access to our Learning Academy
• Test and learn new approaches in a safe, inclusive environment
• Start building a professional network
• Grow your confidence, build your resilience, and elevate your presence
• Experience first-hand what it’s like working in a purpose-driven organisation
Entry requirements

• To be in your penultimate year of university
• To be on course to achieving a 2:1 in a STEM subject
• Clear communication skills, and the ability to break down complex problems and explain your ideas
• A curious, logical mindset with a passion for solving problems and exploring emerging technologies, including AI
• Confidence working with data, statistics, and experimentation, and evidence-based decision making
• A flexible attitude, comfortable with change and ambiguity and continuous learning in a rapidly evolving technology landscape
• A drive to learn, grow, and make a real impact

As MarTech Lead, you will drive the successful delivery of a complex and evolving marketing technology roadmap spanning customer engagement, data infrastructure, performance marketing measurement and AI enablement.
Your role in the Team’s Success
Own the SFMC → Braze Migration
• Act as the technical owner of the SFMC → Braze migration: own the plan, sequencing, and cutover strategy, not just a workstream within it
• Develop and lead a QA plan to validate data and journey parity between SFMC and Braze, including reconciliation of records, journey logic and event data, with hands-on checks at the SQL/pipeline level where needed.
• Identify and fix migration-related data issues directly (mapping errors, duplicate/missing events, broken triggers) rather than logging tickets for someone else to resolve
• Own the technical relationship with Client Tech and Data Architecture for everything migration-related: uptime, data integrity, and rollback/contingency planning
Build the source of truth
• Work with the support of Data Engineers to Define the technical architecture for a unique source of truth: schema design, identity resolution/stitching across tools, update cadence, and ownership of conflicts when tools disagree
• Manage integrations of 3rd-party tools, understanding the technical data contracts involved; spec how data from disparate tools should be integrated, deduplicated, and reconciled into a single, trusted data store
• Work with Data Architecture and the data warehouse team to align this with the existing BigQuery/attribution setup
• Build validation/monitoring so the source of truth is trusted by default; flag drift or breakage before stakeholders notice bad numbers
Technical ownership
• Where possible diagnose and resolve data quality issues directly (duplicate events, integer overflow/ID issues, broken field mappings, integration failures) rather than escalating to a data engineer
• Use AI tools (LLM-based agents, scripting, internal automation) to speed up recurring MarTech work: QA checks, documentation, campaign audits, migration validation, training material generation etc.
• Manage vendor relationships
What you’ll need for this role
You’re a technologist first, not a project coordinator. Someone who’s more comfortable in a SQL console or a data pipeline than in a status meeting, and who reaches for AI tools instinctively to move faster rather than waiting for someone else to build the tool for you.
You are comfortable operating in ambiguity, able to connect the dots between teams and skilled at turning broad goals into practical technical plans. You understand how marketing technology, measurement and data work together at a hands-on level, not just conceptually.
You will likely bring:
• Strong ability to translate business objectives into structured delivery plans, requirements and documentation
• Clear, confident communication skills with the ability to work effectively across teams with different priorities, disciplines and levels of technical understanding
• Experience managing multiple initiatives in parallel, including coordination of external vendors and delivery partners, while maintaining focus on outcomes
• Strong SQL and comfort working in BigQuery or an equivalent warehouse. You can write your own validation queries, not just request them
• Practical experience building with AI/LLM tools: automating a workflow, building an internal agent, or similar, beyond casual chatbot use
• Experience owning (not just contributing to) at least one platform migration or major data integration project
• Comfort working with Data Engineering teams to contribute in the design of data architecture
The Perks
It really is more than a job. We think like a start-up, but we deliver like a FTSE 100 — so the bar is high, and we won't pretend otherwise. We work hybrid, which means three days in the office. We’ll recognise your talent and make sure that you can still have a life – at work, and outside of it. Networks, committees, awards, sports and social clubs, mentorships, volunteering opportunities, extra time off… the list goes on.

Ecologist / Ecological Clerk of Works (ECoW) – England & Wales
Reporting To: SHEQ Manager
Location: England & Wales – project based with regular travel to live construction sites
Function: SHEQ / Environment
Role Purpose
The Ecologist / Ecological Clerk of Works (ECoW) will provide specialist ecological advice, assurance and site-based support across infrastructure and construction projects throughout England and Wales.
Reporting to the SHEQ Manager, the role will ensure that construction activities are planned and undertaken in accordance with ecological legislation, planning conditions, client requirements, environmental permits, licences and project environmental commitments.
The role will work closely with project management, engineering, construction and environmental teams to identify ecological risks at an early stage and ensure appropriate mitigation is incorporated into the planning and delivery of works.
A key element of the position will be providing practical ECoW support on live construction sites, including pre-construction surveys, ecological inspections, watching briefs, toolbox talks and monitoring of sensitive works.
Key Responsibilities
Ecological Clerk of Works
• Act as ECoW for construction activities where ecological supervision or specialist advice is required.
• Undertake pre-construction ecological checks and surveys.
• Provide ecological watching briefs during potentially sensitive construction activities.
• Identify ecological constraints and communicate appropriate controls to project teams.
• Stop, pause or escalate works where there is a risk of ecological harm or breach of licence, consent or legal requirement.
• Provide advice on appropriate exclusion zones, buffers and working methods.
• Maintain accurate records of ecological inspections, observations, interventions and actions.
Protected Species
Provide specialist advice and site support relating to protected and notable species including, where relevant:
• Bats.
• Badgers.
• Great crested newts.
• Otters.
• Water voles.
• Reptiles.
• Breeding and nesting birds.
• Barn owls.
• Dormice.
• Invasive non-native species.
• Other protected or priority species identified through project surveys.
Ensure project teams understand and comply with applicable protected species licences and mitigation requirements.
Surveys & Assessments
• Undertake or coordinate Preliminary Ecological Appraisals (PEAs).
• Support UKHab habitat surveys and condition assessments.
• Undertake protected species surveys within the individual's competence and relevant professional guidance.
• Review ecological survey reports produced by consultants.
• Support ecological input into Environmental Impact Assessments and project environmental documentation.
• Identify requirements for additional specialist surveys and consultants.
Construction Support
• Review RAMS and construction methodologies from an ecological perspective.
• Provide ecological input into Construction Environmental Management Plans (CEMPs).
• Support preparation and implementation of Ecological Management Plans and Species Protection Plans.
• Undertake pre-start briefings and ecological toolbox talks.
• Work collaboratively with Site Managers, Engineers and Supervisors to develop practical solutions to ecological constraints.
• Attend construction and environmental planning meetings where required.
Biodiversity Net Gain
• Support project compliance with applicable Biodiversity Net Gain requirements.
• Assist with baseline habitat assessments and condition assessments.
• Support development and implementation of biodiversity enhancement measures.
• Monitor delivery of habitat creation, restoration and enhancement commitments.
• Support collection and maintenance of evidence required to demonstrate delivery of biodiversity commitments.
Environmental Compliance
Provide ecological advice in relation to applicable requirements including:
• Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981.
• Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations 2017.
• Protection of Badgers Act 1992.
• Environment Act 2021.
• Countryside and Rights of Way Act 2000.
• Natural Environment and Rural Communities Act 2006.
• Applicable planning conditions, licences and consents.
Maintain awareness of legislative and regulatory changes relevant to project activities.
Pollution Prevention & Environmental Support
While primarily an ecological role, provide environmental support where required, particularly where construction activities could affect:
• Watercourses and aquatic habitats.
• Protected sites.
• Trees and vegetation.
• Sensitive habitats.
• Soil and habitat reinstatement.
• Invasive species.
• Habitat fragmentation and disturbance.
Ecological Incidents
• Respond to ecological incidents, unexpected discoveries and potential breaches.
• Provide immediate advice to project teams on appropriate actions.
• Support environmental incident investigations.
• Liaise with the SHEQ Manager and Environmental Manager regarding significant ecological issues.
• Support regulatory notifications where required.
• Ensure lessons learned are communicated across project teams.
Stakeholder Engagement
Develop effective relationships with project teams, clients, landowners, environmental consultants and statutory bodies including Natural England, Natural Resources Wales and relevant local authorities.
Represent the project at ecological and environmental meetings where required.
Reporting & Assurance
• Produce ecological inspection and monitoring reports.
• Maintain ecological constraints and action registers.
• Track ecological actions through to closure.
• Provide ecological information for project SHEQ reporting.
• Support client environmental audits and assurance visits.
• Maintain appropriate evidence demonstrating compliance with licences, planning conditions and ecological commitments.
Key Accountabilities
The role is accountable for:
• Effective identification and management of ecological risks.
• Delivery of competent ECoW support.
• Compliance with protected species requirements.
• Implementation of ecological mitigation measures.
• Accurate ecological records and evidence.
• Timely escalation of significant ecological risks.
• Supporting delivery of project biodiversity commitments.
• Preventing avoidable ecological harm arising from construction activities.
Essential Qualifications
• Degree or equivalent qualification in Ecology, Environmental Science, Conservation Biology or a related discipline.
• Appropriate professional membership of CIEEM or equivalent.
• Good working knowledge of ecological legislation applicable to England and Wales.
• Full UK Driving Licence.
Desirable Qualifications
• Associate or Full Membership of CIEEM.
• Protected species survey licences relevant to the project portfolio.
• CSCS/ECS or equivalent construction site competence.
• ECoW training or demonstrable equivalent experience.
• UKHab training.
• Biodiversity Net Gain assessment experience.
• Environmental auditing…

​​About Us:
Airbus is Europe’s number one Defence and Space enterprise, so what better way to start your Craft Apprenticeship than with an industry leader.
Being a Satellites AIT Craft Apprentice at Airbus means you will get to develop both Mechanical and Electrical skills at Satellite level to Assemble, Integrate and Test hardware to deliver world class products to the launch pad.
This apprenticeship offers a unique opportunity to launch your career in the fascinating world of Satellite Assembly, Integration and Test. As a Satellites AIT Craft Apprentice, you'll be part of a team and gain hands-on experience in a supportive and innovative environment, contributing to projects that push the boundaries of technology.
This programme is perfect for those with a passion for both mechanical and electrical precision, a knack for problem-solving, and a keen interest in seeing their work take flight. Join us in shaping the future of space exploration!
What you will be doing
Year 1: You will study towards a Level 2 Engineering Operative ST0537 on the electrical pathway, gaining both academic knowledge and practical experience.
Year 2: During the Apprenticeship you will have a unique opportunity to experience our Satellites AIT Production area of the business which will provide you with a comprehensive understanding of how a Satellite is manufactured at Airbus Defence & Space.
This includes working in small teams or on a one-to-one basis to manufacture Satellites using the latest approved processes and advanced production techniques for Satellite manufacture.
Your key activities & responsibilities will be:
Mechanical Assembly
• Use of various different adhesives and bonding methods
• Use of hand measuring tools to meet tight tolerances
• Installation of various components to satellite structures
• Installation of various connector brackets
• Bonding of Heater Mats, Thermocouples and Thermostats to various surfaces
• Following process and tolerances to drawings on 3DX
Electrical
• Perform electrical assembly, integration and modification of electrical systems (harness routing, electrical connection, soldering, crimping).
• Perform basic electrical tests (continuity, bonding, insulation, DC high voltage).
• Perform first level quality inspection.
• You will handle raw materials, tools, standard parts and components, documentation (technical instruction, work order, test procedure, job card, etc).
Year 3: You will be fully on-site, fine tuning your hand skills against the business skills matrix.
Requirements
